records.title: TCP versus UDP: loss, congestion, connections, and retransmission
evidence: Schema, references, objective answer structure and minimum teaching components checked.
Independent text review: TCP stream ordering, UDP message behavior, receiver flow control, and network congestion are correctly separated.

limitations: Complete acceptance review not yet recorded.

records.title: TLS, certificates, termination, and trust boundaries
evidence: Schema, references, objective answer structure and minimum teaching components checked.

limitations: Complete acceptance review not yet recorded.

records.title: HTTP semantics: methods, status codes, safety, and idempotence
evidence: Schema, references, objective answer structure and minimum teaching components checked.
Independent text review: safe/idempotent/cacheable are distinct; repeated effect does not require identical response bytes.

limitations: Complete acceptance review not yet recorded.

records.title: [A] Trace and troubleshoot a request from browser to backend
evidence: Schema, references, objective answer structure and minimum teaching components checked.

records.title: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, multiplexing, and head-of-line blocking
evidence: Schema, references, objective answer structure and minimum teaching components checked.

records.title: REST versus RPC/gRPC: contracts, serialization, and coupling
evidence: Schema, references, objective answer structure and minimum teaching components checked.
